articles.summary: TORONTO, Ontario – January 23, 2026 – Blue Moon Metals Inc.(“Blue Moon” or the “Company”) (TSXV: MOON; Z: BMM, Frankfurt: 8SX0), today announced that on Monday January 26th, its common shares will commence trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol “BMM”. The common shares will continue to trade on the TSXV Venture Exchange under the symbol “MOON” and […]
articles.title: Blue Moon Metals to Begin Trading on Nasdaq under BMM and Appoints Peter Madsen to the Board of Directors - Blue Moon Metals Inc.
